narrative.overview: A working tool on a dark bench with the drawings laid out on paper in the middle of it. The chrome steps back; the drawings and the Check table are light paper with ink. Colour is information: one blue for selection, focus and the primary action; three status colours for results; everything else grey.
keyCharacteristics: Dark chrome, light drawings; the paper is the hero.
Status colour only where a result is stated.
One face at a small set of sizes.
Mixed-case labels; rule IDs the only capitals.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Survey Blue marks selection, focus and the primary action, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Status Means Result Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber appear only where a result is stated.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Floor
rules.body: No interface text is smaller than 12 px.

rules.name: The Mixed-Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere; capitals only for rule IDs, sheet numbers and the wordmark.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Panels sit flat; a shadow means it floats above your work.

dos: Do keep every interface text at 12 px or more, and every control's hit area at least 24 x 24 px.
Do use Survey Blue only for selection, focus and the one primary action.
Do write labels in sentence case with the screen's own names for things.
Do say why a control is disabled.
donts: Don't set letter-spaced capitals on labels or headings.
Don't use status colours outside a stated result.
Don't change the canvases or the sheets from here.
Don't add shadows to panels or cards on the bench.
